name: rendered-markdown-diff
description: Obsidian plugin: rendered side-by-side diff of a note against git

scripts.test: esbuild test/core.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test/.out/core.test.cjs --external:jsdom --log-level=warning && esbuild test/git.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=test/.out/git.test.cjs --log-level=warning && node --test test/.out/core.test.cjs test/.out/git.test.cjs

author: Enrique D'Angelo
